title: Community Corner: LightsOut Empowerment continues to elevate the lives of young people - NewsBreak
text:
By Kim Gusby ,
1 days ago
Liberty County, GA (WSAV-TV) — Its mission is to strengthen and elevate the lives of young people in our community.
Larry Murray, Jr. is the CEO and Founder Lightsout Empowerment, Inc.— a grassroots organization building the next generation of leaders.
He sat down with WSAV’s Kim Gusby to talk about what the organization is planning for the summer and fall for area students and how you can get involved.
Click the arrow in the video box above to watch the interview.
